mapper.select: SELECT STATUS FROM TASKS WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ROUND_NO), 0) FROM DESIGN_ROUND WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DESIGN_ROUND (TASK_ID, ROUND_NO, BID_CASE_ID, OPENED_BY, OPENED_VERIFIED, OPENED_AT, RECIP_COUNT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{roundNo}, #{bidCaseId}, #{openedBy}, #{verified}, #{openedAt}, #{recipCount})
INSERT INTO DESIGN_ROUND_RECIP (TASK_ID, ROUND_NO, EMP_NO, REASON_CD, NOTIFICATION_ID) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{roundNo}, #{empNo}, #{reasonCd}, #{notificationId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DESIGN_ROUND_RECIP WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ROUND_NO = #{roundNo} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DESIGN_ROUND_RECIP WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DESIGN_COMMENT WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ROUND_NO = #{roundNo} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DESIGN_COMMENT (TASK_ID, ROUND_NO, EMP_NO, SEQ_NO, BODY, EMP_VERIFIED, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{roundNo}, #{empNo}, #{seqNo}, #{body}, #{verified}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DESIGN_ACK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ROUND_NO = #{roundNo} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DESIGN_ACK (TASK_ID, ROUND_NO, EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, ACKED_AT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{roundNo}, #{empNo}, #{verified}, #{ackedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT R.TASK_ID, R.ROUND_NO, R.BID_CASE_ID, R.OPENED_BY, U.NAME AS OPENED_BY_NAME, R.OPENED_AT, R.RECIP_COUNT, R.CLOSED_AT, R.CLOSE_CD, R.CLOSED_BY FROM DESIGN_ROUND R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = R.OPENED_BY WHERE R.TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY R.ROUND_NO

SELECT P.ROUND_NO, P.EMP_NO, U.NAME, P.REASON_CD, A.ACKED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DESIGN_COMMENT C WHERE C.TASK_ID = P.TASK_ID AND C.ROUND_NO = P.ROUND_NO AND C.EMP_NO = P.EMP_NO) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM DESIGN_ROUND_RECIP P LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = P.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN DESIGN_ACK A ON A.TASK_ID = P.TASK_ID AND A.ROUND_NO = P.ROUND_NO AND A.EMP_NO = P.EMP_NO WHERE P.TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY P.ROUND_NO, U.NAME, P.EMP_NO

SELECT C.ROUND_NO, C.EMP_NO, U.NAME, C.SEQ_NO, C.BODY, C.CREATED_AT FROM DESIGN_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = C.EMP_NO WHERE C.TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY C.ROUND_NO, C.CREATED_AT, C.EMP_NO, C.SEQ_NO
